images.title: 32 numbers between 256 and 289
images.purpose: Shows 32 whole numbers lying strictly between 16 squared and 17 squared on a number line.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One long number line across the centre with its two end points labelled and one brace below.
images.exact_structure: One horizontal number line. A large teal (#0072B2) dot at the left end labelled 16² = 256 and a large teal (#0072B2) dot at the right end labelled 17² = 289. Between them exactly 32 short evenly spaced amber (#E69F00) ticks, with no labels on the ticks. A brace below the 32 ticks is labelled 32 numbers. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Between n² and the next square lie exactly 2n numbers.
images.description: Shows 32 whole numbers lying strictly between 16 squared and 17 squared on a number line.

image_decisions.why: Seeing the 32 ticks between the two squares checks the 2n rule without listing every number.
